paper_metadata.title: High-Frequency CML Clock Dividers in 0.13-m CMOS Operating Up to 38 GHz
paper_metadata.abstract: The analysis and design of two novel high-speed CMOS clock dividers is discussed. The realizations of these circuits in a 0.13m CMOS process show a significant improvement in high-frequency operation compared to a conventional D flip-flop-based divider. Measured sensitivity curves of these dividers give maximum frequency of operation ranging from 20 to 38 GHz with power consumption of 12 mW from a 1.8-V supply voltage.
